metadata.document: State lifecycle and duration — Group C owner approval
metadata.approved_scope: All ten recommended resolutions in the Group C review: CI-008, CI-009, BUF-008, BUF-009, BUF-010, BUF-011, BUF-014, RSRX-07, RSRX-08, RSRX-10.

decisions.approved_resolution: Emit round_close after immutable score/result snapshot; expire only round_close grants in every zone, including terminal round; preserve permanent_instance grants.
Store intrinsic_weather_resistance in DefinitionSnapshot and source/event/expiry-tracked weather_resistance_modifiers on the instance; legacy scalar is non-canonical.
Keep printed_row immutable; current_row null outside board; persist last_board_row; keep player/round last_unit_play_row and update only after successful unit play.
Default protection blocks unit_removal and execution; sacrifice bypasses; statuses/debuffs are not blocked by default; preserve Noite/Chama and Lâmina Negra as explicit effect-specific exceptions.
Consume exactly one compatible protection charge on block; keep action_cost_on_block separate; Noite/Chama consumes activation, Lâmina Negra does not.
vigil_seal creates a weather resistance modifier expiring on board_exit; inactive generic resistencia_climatica branch remains excluded unless rebound and verified.
Represent bonus as traceable grants with signed amount, source, applied_event_id, expiry and per-effect/release clamp_policy_id; no implicit global floor/ceiling.
Ressurgir/Réquiem use reset_to_zero; Esgar uses previous_bonus_plus_one with the +1 as separate grant/event; Lágrima Sagrada is hand recovery, not resurrection.
Ressurgir/Réquiem use last_board_row, then valid requested row, then melee; Esgar forces a valid requested row and rejects missing/invalid row.

Return to board clears status applications and protection grants; applies effect-specific bonus/row policy; preserves intrinsic resistance and still-active round_close/permanent_instance grants; does not replay on-play, faction passive or combo hooks.

not_approved_by_this_record: Final negative-status stack caps, threshold transitions and repeated-trigger policy for Malenia/Oracle of Frost.
Complete target selection, fallback, partial-target and operation outcome semantics (Group D).
Real persistence, concurrency, CAS/locks and legacy snapshot migration (Group E).
Final numeric balance values and concrete clamp_policy_id assignments for every effect.
